title: Prospect insights
description: The `data` of GET /v2/drip-campaigns/:campaignId/prospects/insights?email=<email>: the newest answer KexyApi stored from the Prospect Insights API (called once per AI email, just before it is written; see KexyApi docs/insights-api-mapping.md). Drives the left column of the prospect profile ('Why we chose this lead', 'How we picked the opening topic'). 403 until the prospect has opened an email; with no answer yet, callout/openerSelection/generatedAt are null and signals is []. 'What happened so far' and who the prospect is are NOT part of this API. openerSelection.outcome is worked out by KexyApi from its own tracking (drip_campaign_insignts), never taken from the AI. The standard ResponseSuccessInterceptor wraps it as { success, statusCode, path, data, timestamp }. Every piece of text is shown to the user as-is.

email.description: The prospect's email, echoed back exactly as requested.

callout.description: Highlighted box at the top of 'Why we chose this lead'. Rendered as 'title message Next step: nextStep'. null to hide it.

tone.description: 'replied', 'positive', 'neutral' and 'warning' get their own colour; any other tone is shown neutral.

nextStep.description: Text after 'Next step:'. null to omit.

signals.description: Everything found about the prospect, ORDERED BY confidence DESCENDING, at most 10 (keep the most confident). The UI shows the first two and puts the rest behind '+N more, lower confidence · view all'. May be empty.

openerSelection.description: 'How we picked the opening topic'. null before any opener has been chosen.

winnerKey.description: The opening angle chosen for the email (Insights' openerSelection.winnerKey). Usually one of candidates; when no angle cleared its floor the Lambda still names the best one and candidates may not include it (the page then names it from the angle).

outcome.description: What happened with the email the winning opener was used in, from KexyApi's tracking. pending = not sent yet; no_response = nothing yet and a later email has gone out.

signalId.description: The signals[].id behind the winning angle (Insights' openerSelection.signalId). null when the answer names none (answers from before the Lambda added it) or names a signal not in signals.

candidates.description: Every opener that cleared its floor, used ones included, ORDERED BY score DESCENDING. May be empty (see winnerKey).

rule.description: Footnote under the bars. null to hide.

generatedAt.description: When this answer was produced (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there is no answer yet.

kind.description: The kind of fact, as the Insights API labels it: linkedin_share, linkedin_post, city, company_news, pain_point, lead_magnet or other. Kept a plain string so a new value never fails a response; the page shows title, never this.

title.description: Card heading, e.g. 'What he shared on LinkedIn'.

timing.description: Grey text after the heading, e.g. '5 days before we emailed' or 'recent'.

quote.description: The prospect's words, verbatim. No surrounding quote marks — the UI adds them.

attribution.description: e.g. 'shared by John McDonald' or 'his own post'.

url.description: Link to the original. Shows 'View post' when set.

usedIn.description: Set when this signal opened a sent email, from KexyApi's records (the stored openerSelection.signalId of each sent email), never from the AI. Shows a badge like 'OPENED EMAIL 1 · GOT THE REPLY'.

emailSequence.description: 1-based position of the email in the drip sequence.

label.description: e.g. 'Why we used it' or 'Why it matters'.
